title: Choose Kopi Papa's ordering world
question: Each direction keeps ordering fast and clear. Choose the visual system that should make Kopi Papa recognisable.

options.label: Pickup Departure Board
options.thesis: Ordering feels like catching the next perfectly timed pickup.
options.viewport: The selected shop and live pickup estimate form one bold departure strip above a fast photographic menu.
options.risk: Could feel too utilitarian unless food photography and warm ticket details keep it hospitable.

raised.raise: Prices, modifiers, and totals inherit ledger-grade alignment and precision.
Order-state changes gain one memorable mechanical step-and-settle motion.

options.label: Kopitiam Order Chit
options.lineage: hand-marked kopitiam order slips and counter dockets
options.thesis: The familiar order chit becomes a precise, modern mobile ritual.
options.viewport: A warm paper surface leads with shop and wait time, then neatly ruled category tabs and generous drink photography.
options.risk: This is the most culturally resonant option, but it becomes nostalgic if the typography or motion feels theatrical.

options.label: Counter Wayfinding
options.thesis: Every ordering decision is signed like the next clear turn through a terminal.
options.viewport: A monumental pickup sign names the shop and wait, while categories become a chain of obvious next decisions.
options.case: Excellent product clarity and accessibility; slightly weaker connection to a neighbourhood coffee ritual.
options.risk: Yellow wayfinding can dominate the drinks unless carefully confined to decisions and status.

options.label: Ready Number Display
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks and pickup number displays
options.thesis: Availability, wait time, price, and order number glow with absolute certainty.
options.viewport: A calm cream menu is punctuated by one dark instrument strip showing the next pickup and live wait time.
options.case: Strong for operational status and repeat use; less expressive for browsing twenty distinctive drinks.
options.risk: Too much display language would make the menu feel like equipment rather than hospitality.

options.label: Coffee Ledger
options.thesis: The menu reads as a beautifully indexed coffee reference.
options.viewport: A compact menu index surrounds one fixed category rail with exact price and modifier notation.
options.case: Precise but too reading-heavy for hurried, one-handed ordering.
options.kept: Its disciplined alignment raises every price, modifier, and total in the selected direction.
options.risk: Dense editorial measures would slow scanning on small phones.

options.label: Depot Blind
options.thesis: Order states advance as tactile destination courses.
options.viewport: The live order destination occupies one fixed window above a pared-back menu.
options.case: Memorable status motion, but the cloth system is too narrow to carry product browsing alone.
options.kept: Its one-course mechanical step becomes the signature order-status transition.
options.risk: Literal fabric treatments could obscure product imagery and accessibility.

canonCard.label: Polished ordering standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar modern coffee menu executed with exceptional clarity.
canonCard.viewport: Pickup selector, store row, promotion, category rail, product cards, and persistent cart follow the expected ordering pattern.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable, but deliberately difficult to distinguish from established competitors.
